test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two types of cell divisions, A and B, are shown in the figure below. Which option provides the correct answer for:

i. Types of cell division

ii. When and where does division B take place?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9d429baca6b4e7143fed4988a189915cb65bf11f7b0caf994e96761a98a0293.png]

options.text:
i. A - Meiosis, B - Mitosis

ii. Meiosis takes place in reproductive cells for the formation of gametes

i. A - Mitosis, B - Meiosis

ii. Meiosis takes place in reproductive cells for the formation of gametes

i. A and B - Meiosis

ii. Meiosis takes place in body cells for growth

i. A - Mitosis, B - Meiosis

ii. Meiosis takes place in body cells for growth

solution:
The correct answer is 

i. A - Mitosis, B - Meiosis

ii. Meiosis takes place in reproductive cells for the formation of gametes

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Meiosis** is a type of cell division that results in the **formation of four daughter cells **each with **half the number of chromosomes** as the parent cell.
 
• **Mitosis** is the type of cell division that results in the** formation of two daughter cells** each with the **same number and kind of chromosomes** as the parent cell.
 
• Mitosis is the process where the **division of cells occurs by asexual reproduction.**
 
• The meiosis mode of** reproduction is through sexual reproduction **and takes place in **reproductive cells to form gametes.**
 
• So from the question, it is clear that A - Mitosis, B - Meiosis, and **Meiosis takes place in all the cells of the body.**

​So, **option 2)** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mitosis and meiosis take **place in the cell nuclei where both involve cell division**.
 
• Both processes occur in the **M-phase** of the cell cycle.
 
• In both cycles, the stages are common- **prophase, metaphase, anaphase and telophase.**
 
• **Synthesis of DNA **occurs in both processes.
